name: Explosion
primary:
Megumin's one and only spell from KonoSuba. Three spinning crimson magic circles stack above the aimed spot for 2 s, then a pillar of light strikes it. Everyone within 8 blocks:
• Damage 12 ❤ fire
• Heat 120
• Thrown far away
It blasts a crater of up to 60 blocks and leaves a mushroom cloud.
The price: for 8 s you cannot cast any element, get Slowness IV and Weakness II.
self_description: The blast goes off at your feet and throws you high into the air with slow falling for 8 s; you take no damage from it. The price is the same.
